high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from a Twitter post by the verified account "businessinsider." The post is part of a series, as indicated by the number "2/4" at the top right corner, suggesting it is the second part of a four-part article or report. The content of the tweet discusses findings from a report by Japanese authorities regarding overtime laws. The text states that nearly 9,000 companies breached overtime laws last year, and the ministry confirmed cases of workers pulling more than 100 hours of overtime work a month in 1,878 workplaces. It also mentions government efforts to curb overtime
